ctx.x: He's got some. He's got some. He's got some. He's got some. He's got some. He's got some. He's got some. Were you brought up in the Catholic religion? Oh yeah. I've brought up in the Catholic religion? Oh yeah. No, no.

I've brought up most in Baptist for a long year. Long year. That's when my wife was Catholic. So, I got it. Then I was used to do church. Did the brass bands play for the churches in those days? Oh yeah, they used to play for churches. Used to play for churches. Used to play for churches. They used to play for churches. stuff Boogie Boogie good, he ain't full of that. But he can play music, he can learn all that. But the people now, the more, the young people, the more, the boogie. Yeah, rock and roll.
When you were youngsters, where would the brass bands be playing? Huh? When you were a youngster, where would the brass bands be playing? Would they play out in the streets?
